method: Authorized Supabase read-only pg_policies, pg_proc, pg_namespace, ACL inspection; no user/session records retrieved
security_invariants: Existing private.ordax_authenticated_subject_eligible_v1 reads auth.uid and signed JWT session_id and checks auth.sessions/auth.users/account status; every rewritten client-facing policy must retain this exact gate.
RLS rewrites may change ONLY trusted function schema entrypoints, not entitlement expiration, ownership, project/space memberships or WITH CHECK logic.
Delegate to current private functions rather than copying existing authorization business rules.
Create no permissive anonymous policy or new write grant.
Migration fails if observed public policy set or helper ownership/security differs.
Do not revoke direct API roles until every policy uses the new tightly scoped wrapper.
limitations: Evidence is not a cryptographic attestation of remote database state.
Live eligibility function was observed in the target database but does not yet have an identified owning migration in the current repository; reconcile ownership before deployment.
Only a controlled rehearsal against a representative isolated database with two independent test identities can authorize live deployment.
